name: Pebble Shell
summary: The whole DeNon desktop: Pebble Shell rail, control corner, search-first menu, recessed windows, fastfetch
notes: Big one: replaces the bar layout, Hyprland look and keys, fastfetch and foot, and adds 24 shell plugins. Its installer lists everything and asks again before changing anything.
removeNotes: Its installer backed up everything it replaced to ~/.config/omarchy-dotfiles-backup/<time>/; copy those back to undo it.
